title: MTMCS-Bench: Evaluating Contextual Safety of Multimodal Large Language Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues
reasoning: The paper evaluates the 'contextual safety' and moral/ethical alignment of multimodal LLMs. It introduces a benchmark specifically designed to test whether models recognize and refuse prompts related to harmful or unethical activities such as harassment, illegal acts, and self-harm, which constitutes a core component of benchmarking AI ethics.
